posts.cooked:
When Pterodactyl Thief is destroyed it returns cards beneath it to the players hands.  So if you kill it before then it does nothing.

So if you had End of Days and played it now and marked the Thief with Zealous offense, at the start of the environment turn Pterodactyl thief would trigger first (order in play) and take all your equipment and put it under itself, do no damage, then as long as you had the Thief destroyed before the cards under it those cards would go back to your hand.

Too bad you don't have end of days and the field isn't full of bad guys, that would have been awesome.

 

Also, because you are close to flipping gloomy:

Even if the third relic enters play by the Cultists-> Relics option Gloomy won't flip till the next turn.  Also he reforms the deck after flipping, so the Vast followings and all cultists will be back in the deck.  (This is key if only one relic survives the flip, as the others will come back out rather soon)

I've really enjoyed this game so far, and I already know of some changes I will make to his second side to make it better.
